title: Brown representability in a Grothendieck abelian category
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma is Brown representability for a Grothendieck abelian category: a functor on the opposite category into sets is representable exactly when it commutes with colimits (statement lines 2119-2128). The proof is a complete argument: the easy direction is the definition of a colimit (proof lines 2130-2132); the converse constructs a candidate representing object as a colimit of subobjects generated by the elements of the functor, which are small thanks to the cited smallness results (proof lines 2134-2172); and the verification that the represented functor is isomorphic to the given one is carried out by exhibiting the inverse on the quotient determined by the kernel of the universal map, with the details of that last check omitted in one sentence (proof lines 2173-2185). The non-formal content is the construction of the representing object and the inverse. The claim is H3.
